games.missingness_rule: Only an empty string is an empty cell. Source markers remain literal values; absent columns are reported separately. No missing-to-zero conversion.

plays.missingness_rule: Only an empty string is an empty cell. Source markers remain literal values; absent columns are reported separately. No missing-to-zero conversion.

people.missingness_rule: Only an empty string is an empty cell. Source markers remain literal values; absent columns are reported separately. No missing-to-zero conversion.

japan_board.missingness_rule: Only an empty string is an empty cell. Source markers remain literal values; absent columns are reported separately. No missing-to-zero conversion.

weather.missingness_rule: Only an empty string is an empty cell. Source markers remain literal values; absent columns are reported separately. No missing-to-zero conversion.

play_checks.limits: Checks compare official parsed CSV to official Game Logs. Not independent scorecard verification, full event grammar replay, or pitch-tracking validation. Runner substitutions compare occupancy, not identity; automatic runners across innings are not validated.

identity_join.join_rule: Exact key_retro only; key_uuid is the stable primary ID. No name matching. Japanese board has no external player IDs, so it is not automatically joined.

deferred.reason: MLB一次提供元の自動取得・利用・再配布条件が未解決。二次配布やクライアントのコードライセンスを根拠に本体を取得しない。
NPB公式の二次利用・無断転載に関する表示。用途別の許諾・適用条件の確認後に判断。
OpenBiomechanicsは非商用・継承条件と追加の利用者制限があり、今回の採用を保留。
現行Bulk Hourly資料は data.meteostat.net/hourly/{year}.parquet の年別全体配布を案内。モデル補完と変数別_sourceあり。古い観測所年別CSVの存在を前提に取得せず、小分け取得を次回検証。証拠 https://dev.meteostat.net/data/bulk/hourly.html

selection.rule: First 4/last 4 chronologically; up to 8 each of extra-inning/doubleheader/resumed games, then chronological fill. Deterministic nonrandom engineering sample, not a representative population.

limits: No model training or simulator calibration in stage 2.
All source columns remain strings or original nested values. No silent imputation; units and measurement definitions remain in hashed source documentation.
JPL board is secondary metadata/scouting; no external player IDs or per-row verification/source columns. No automatic merge or capability estimates.
JMA hourly station data is independent of sampled MLB games. No stadium/weather join or microclimate inference.
ID reference is fully scanned at one commit, but normalized people include only sampled batter/pitcher matches and 100 NPB-ID examples; other roles are not joined.
Retrosheet Game Logs and parsed plays have shared provenance. Matching totals is internal consistency, not independent corroboration.
